## Docket 1.2.6

**A proxy must not veto the measurement standing next to it.**

**A product that is coming soon is not an unfinished page.** A 191-word launch
teaser — "Coming soon: our brand-new home battery range… backed by a 12-year
warranty" — was reported at HIGH as unfinished content, with advice to noindex
it. Docket had already worked out that nothing on the page claimed the *page*
was unfinished, and threw that answer away because the page was nine words short
of a length threshold. The length test stays, because the clearest holding pages
("Coming soon!", "Site under construction") say nothing about themselves either
— but it now means what it says.

**Unrelated pages that returned the same body are not duplicate content.** A
report said 56 pages had identical content and to 301-redirect them. Fifty-four
of those were unrelated pages — the blog, the press page, the FAQs, EV tariffs —
which had all been handed one short stand-in body during the crawl; re-fetched,
they serve thousands of words of entirely different content. Following that
advice would have merged a site's sections into one page. Docket now says what
actually happened and never recommends redirecting them. Genuine duplicates —
URL variants, product colour variants — are unaffected.
